title: The Patient Harvest
author: Noor Oyelaran
blurb: Zephyrine Almeida, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
